descriptions.Magic Missile: ⚡ Action | Cost: 1 Spell SlotYou create three glowing magical darts. Each dart hits a creature and deals 1d4+1 force damage.
descriptions.Cure Wounds: ⚡ Action | Cost: 1 Spell SlotA creature you touch regains hit points equal to 1d8 + your modifier.
descriptions.Shield: ⚡ Reaction | Cost: 1 Spell SlotAn invisible barrier appears and protects you. You gain a +5 bonus to AC until your next turn.
descriptions.Misty Step: ⚡ Bonus Action | Cost: 1 Spell SlotYou are surrounded by mist and teleport up to 30 feet.
descriptions.Spiritual Weapon: ⚡ Bonus Action | Cost: 1 Spell SlotYou create a floating spectral weapon that strikes a creature.
